worldcombat.skill.toxic.summary: Spit a glob of venom into the target. It burrows deeper every few seconds: each pulse raises the poison a stage so it bites more often, and at the peak it erupts for a chunk of maximum health. A cure makes it wither early.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.0: The venom flies at %2$s blocks per tick and reaches targets within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.1: On a hit the target is badly poisoned; every %1$s ticks the poison deepens one stage, lasting up to %2$s seconds and reaching stage %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.2: At full strength the venom erupts for %1$s%% of the target's maximum health (this can finish it); collision radius %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.0: Open by poisoning a tough target
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.1: Turn a hard fight into a war of attrition
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.2: Force the target to spend a cure or retreat
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.virul: On: shorter venom (x0.72) but faster deepening (interval x0.62) and a heavier eruption (x1.3), to break the target sooner. Off: longer venom (x1.08) with slower deepening, for a long war of attrition.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of spitting. Larger values chase harder and whiff more in the open.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to apply venom; when off, it only spits at what it can reach from where it stands.
